CITY OF ALHAMBRA PLANNING COMMISSION
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  April 4, 2022

  The audio recording of the meeting is available here: PC Meeting – April 4, 2022 (Audio).m4a

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  7:02 P.M. in the Council Chambers of Alhambra City Hall.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Juarez, Mojarro, Olson, Pham, Sahu, Tsujii, Wang, Garcia, Gardea

  Absent:  Ho

  Staff Present: Vanessa Reynoso, Deputy Director; Paul Lam, Principal Planner; Jose
  Hernandez, Planning Aide; Alondra Espinosa, Deputy City Attorney

C.  FLAG SALUTE:  Led by President Gardea.

D.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  •  There were no Consent Agenda Items.

E.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  PRESENTATION AND DISCUSSION REGARDING THE DRAFT
  HISTORIC CONTEXT STATEMENT – ZONE TEXT AMENDMENT AMD-
  22-03 (7:03 P.M.)
  • Citywide
  • Applicant: City of Alhambra
  • Request: The City’s consultant, Historic Resources Group, will
  provide the Planning Commission with a presentation on the Draft
  Historic Context Statement scope and themes. The Historic Context
  Statement will be used in Phase 2 of the City’s Historic Preservation
  Program when conducting the Historic Resources Survey to find
  properties, places and people that are identified in the Statement.
  • Recommended Action: The Planning Commission provide input
  and feedback on the City of Alhambra’s Draft Historic Context
  Statement as part of the development of the City’s Historic
  Preservation Program.
  • Deputy Director Vanessa Reynoso provided the Staff presentation.
  • Historic Resources Group provided a presentation and was
  available to answer questions.
  • Public Comments:
  1.) Jennifer Ng
  2.) Lewis McCammon

  1
  04/04/2022
   MOTION:
  •  Moved to receive and file Agenda Item 1.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Olson, Seconded by Commissioner Sahu.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 9-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Juarez, Mojarro, Olson, Pham, Sahu, Tsujii, Wang,
  Garcia, Gardea
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent: Ho

  •  Recess at 8:59 P.M.
  •  Reconvene at 9:06 P.M.

  AGENDA
  ITEM 2:  PLANNING COMMISSION TRAINING (9:06 P.M.)
  • Request: The Deputy City Attorney will conduct a training session to
  update the Planning Commission on policies and procedures.
  • Recommended Action: Planning Commission receive and file this
  informational report.
  • Deputy City Attorney Alondra Espinosa provided the Staff
  presentation.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to receive and file Agenda Item 2.
  •  Moved by Vice President Garcia, Seconded by Commissioner Sahu.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 9-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Juarez, Mojarro, Olson, Pham, Sahu, Tsujii, Wang,
  Garcia, Gardea
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent: Ho

F.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:

  •  There were no Public Hearings.

G.  DIRECTOR’S REPORT:

  •  Deputy Director Vanessa Reynoso welcomed everyone back to City Hall and in-
  person meetings. (10:14 P.M.)

H.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  •  Lewis McCammon commented it would be helpful to have the presentation posted
  online for the public, as well as videos of the meetings. He added that it is a priority
  to start moving on housing south of the 710 freeway. He provided an update on
  Manni’s Tacos. (10:14 P.M.)

  2
  04/04/2022
 I.  COMMISSION COMMUNICATIONS/ANNOUNCEMENTS:

  •  Commissioner Juarez commended Commissioner Wang for the connection of
  using ADU’s to meet the housing needs. (10:20 P.M.)

  •  Commissioner Wang commented that she is in support of hybrid meetings in order
  to include community members with children and other obligations that are not able
  to attend in person. (10:21 P.M.)

  •  Commissioner Olson agreed that hybrid meetings provide more access and would
  like to see them available. (10:23 P.M.)

  •  Commissioner Mojarro agreed that hybrid meetings should be available. He
  suggested an amnesty program for ADU’s built without permits, a pathway to get
  them to a legal status. (10:23 P.M.)

  •  Commissioner Sahu expressed support for hybrid meetings for the variety of
  reasons including travel and illness. (10:24 P.M.)

  •  President Gardea agreed that he too would like to see the meetings move to a
  hybrid option. (10:26 P.M.)

J.  ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 10:29 P.M. to Monday,
  April 18, 2022, at 7:00 P.M.

  _______________________________
  Chris Olson
  President

ATTEST:

_______________________
Karabeth Garcia
Executive Assistant
